## Helper functions (EMOTE style)

```{r helpers}
# Standardize/rename columns
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
  rename_map <- c(
    "Std_Err"            = "Std_Err",
    "Std.Err"            = "Std_Err",
    "SE"                 = "Std_Err",
    "Observations"       = "Observations",
    "N"                  = "Observations",
    "FirstOrder_Param"   = "FirstOrder_Param",
    "FirstOrder.Parameter"= "FirstOrder_Param",
    "FirstOrderParam"    = "FirstOrder_Param",
    "FirstOrder_StdErr"  = "FirstOrder_StdErr",
    "FirstOrder.StdErr"  = "FirstOrder_StdErr",
    "FO_StdErr"          = "FirstOrder_StdErr",
    "FirstOrder_Obs"     = "FirstOrder_Obs",
    "FirstOrder.Obs"     = "FirstOrder_Obs",
    "FO_Obs"             = "FirstOrder_Obs",
    "Specification"      = "Specification",
    "Spec"               = "Specification",
    "Parameter"          = "Parameter"
  )
  intersecting <- intersect(names(df), names(rename_map))
  if (length(intersecting)) {
    df <- dplyr::rename(df, !!!setNames(rename_map[intersecting], rename_map[intersecting]))
  }
  df
}

# Parse specifications
parse_specification <- function(spec_vec) {
  tibble(
    Proportion = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Proportion")),
    Pearson    = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Pearson")),
    Spearman   = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Spearman")),
    Euclid     = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Euclid")),
    Pairwise   = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Pairwise")),
    Entropy    = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "_Entropy") & !str_detect(spec_vec, "No_Entropy")),
    Start_Date = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Start_Date|Date_and_Time")),
    Response_Window = as.integer(str_detect(spec_vec, "Response_Window|Date_and_Time"))
  )
}

# Create specification plot (heatmap)
create_specification_plot <- function(spec_vec) {
  parsed_data <- parse_specification(spec_vec)
  parsed_data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(parsed_data))
  long_data <- parsed_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Index, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = gsub("Response_Window", "Resp_Wind", Variable),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c(
        "Proportion", "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise",
        "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Resp_Wind"
      )),
      Value = as.factor(Value)
    )
  color_mapping <- c(
    "Proportion" = "steelblue",
    "Pearson" = "seagreen", "Spearman" = "seagreen", "Euclid" = "seagreen",
    "Pairwise" = "darkgoldenrod",
    "Entropy" = "sienna", "Start_Date" = "sienna", "Resp_Wind" = "sienna"
  )
  long_data <- long_data %>%
    mutate(Fill = ifelse(Value == "1", as.character(Variable), NA))
  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Index, y = Variable, fill = Fill)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_mapping,
      na.value = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Specification",
      y = "Analytic Dimension"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Create coefficient plot (overlay main + first-order, EMOTE style)
create_coefficient_plot_sim <- function(df, title) {
  # Use significance: CI doesn't cross 0
  df$Color_Main <- ifelse(df$Lower_Main > 0 | df$Upper_Main < 0, "green3", "tomato")
  df$Color_First <- ifelse(df$Lower_First > 0 | df$Upper_First < 0, "green3", "tomato")
  df$Index <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Index)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Parameter, color = Color_Main), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = FirstOrder_Param, color = Color_First), shape = 17, size = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 2) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    ylim(-0.5, 1.5) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Beta Coefficient"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 44, hjust = 0.2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 35, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt")
    )
}
```

## Combined Null & Quadratic Graphs (Simulation2)

```{r sim2-combined-null-quadratic, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---- Setup ----
sims     <- 0:999
sim2_dir <- "Z:/Projects/EMA_Project/Scripts/Output/Simulation2_Results"
families <- list(
  "Null"      = "Sim_result_y_null_X_sim_%d.csv",
  "Quadratic" = "Sim_result_y_poly2_X_sim_%d.csv"
)
plots_sim2 <- list()
for (fam in names(families)) {
  pattern <- families[[fam]]
  files <- file.path(sim2_dir, sprintf(pattern, sims))
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) next
  # Read and combine
  df <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(fp) {
    data <- suppressMessages(read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE))
    standardize_cols(data)
  })
  # Filter for needed columns
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Parameter), !is.na(FirstOrder_Param))
  # Calculate CI
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Lower_Main = Parameter - 1.96 * Std_Err,
      Upper_Main = Parameter + 1.96 * Std_Err,
      Lower_First = FirstOrder_Param - 1.96 * FirstOrder_StdErr,
      Upper_First = FirstOrder_Param + 1.96 * FirstOrder_StdErr
    ) %>%
    arrange(Parameter)
  # Coefficient plot
  coef_plot <- create_coefficient_plot_sim(df, paste0(fam, " Model"))
  # Spec plot
  spec_plot <- create_specification_plot(df$Specification)
  plots_sim2[[fam]] <- coef_plot / spec_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
}
final_sim2_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_sim2, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Random State Transition Matrices: First vs. Second-Order Multiverse Analysis",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 50, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")))

ggsave(
  filename = "Simulation2_combined_null_quadratic.png",
  plot = final_sim2_plot,
  width = 30,
  height = 30,
  dpi = 300,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

## Combined Null & Quadratic Graphs (Simulation)

```{r sim-combined-null-quadratic, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sim_dir <- "Z:/Projects/EMA_Project/Scripts/Output/Simulation_Results"
families <- list(
  "Null"      = "Sim_result_y_null_RP_sim_%d.csv",
  "Quadratic" = "Sim_result_y_poly2_RP_sim_%d.csv"
)
plots_sim <- list()
for (fam in names(families)) {
  pattern <- families[[fam]]
  files <- file.path(sim_dir, sprintf(pattern, sims))
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) next
  # Read and combine
  df <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(fp) {
    data <- suppressMessages(read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE))
    standardize_cols(data)
  })
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Parameter), !is.na(FirstOrder_Param))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Lower_Main = Parameter - 1.96 * Std_Err,
      Upper_Main = Parameter + 1.96 * Std_Err,
      Lower_First = FirstOrder_Param - 1.96 * FirstOrder_StdErr,
      Upper_First = FirstOrder_Param + 1.96 * FirstOrder_StdErr
    ) %>%
    arrange(Parameter)
  coef_plot <- create_coefficient_plot_sim(df, paste0(fam, " Model"))
  spec_plot <- create_specification_plot(df$Specification)
  plots_sim[[fam]] <- coef_plot / spec_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
}
final_sim_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_sim, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Real State Transition Matrices: First vs. Second-Order Multiverse Analysis",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 50, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")))

ggsave(
  filename = "Simulation_combined_null_quadratic.png",
  plot = final_sim_plot,
  width = 30,
  height = 30,
  dpi = 300,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```
